description: Return 4 style options (style_id, label, preview image_url, source library|yours|brand, source_label, description) for a visual format; the creator's swipe-liked looks (source_label "Your liked style") come first, then approved baselines. ALWAYS call this before the first visual of a request (infographic, carousel, image, quote card, motion, video). If the response has needs_tuning: true, the creator has fewer than 3 liked styles for the format: send them to style_swipe_url (opens in the built-in browser in Claude Code and the desktop app), wait for them to finish, then call this again. Never generate blind, and never render new designs to test taste: taste comes from real top-performer posts. Then show the 4 images as a labelled 2x2, and ask them to pick one, 'show 4 more' (page+1) or 'try another format' (other_formats). Pass the chosen style_id to the generate tool. Read-only; never returns other creators' names, avatars or original posts.

author_id.description: Creator whose approved designs and brand styles are included.
